Hi Marcus, it's paid and on its way out, no tracking on it yet.

Your Bitfortun BS-4 ships direct from the manufacturer, and the batch was packed and due to leave them Monday, November 2. Units from that run started going out this week with Yun Express tracking, so yours should follow within a day or two. The tracking number comes to (email hidden) automatically the moment it leaves, nothing for you to chase.

Sorry it slipped a couple of days past Monday. Anything else I can check while you're here?
